title: Work across text, image and sound
lead: Reporting, photography, video and multimedia projects produced between 2023 and 2025 in Lebanon. Pick a section to explore.

sections.title: Text
sections.description: Op-eds, features, portraits and reports written in Arabic and English for university and newsroom assignments.
sections.note: Each piece is available to download in full.

items.title: جدران الذاكرة — When the walls of the South become memory
items.description: A feature on how murals in the southern Lebanese village of Ainatha turned walls into living archives, preserving the people, traditions and collective memory of a community shaped by war, resilience and its bond with the land.

items.title: Five T's that help you burn fat
items.description: A magazine article setting out five habits — the five T’s — that support fat loss.

items.title: Freedom of expression, ignored
items.description: An opinion article on freedom of expression and how it is set aside in the Lebanese case.

sections.title: Research
sections.description: Media research examining how outlets in different regions frame the same event.

items.title: Western vs regional coverage of the Syrian coast massacre
items.description: How Western outlets such as CNN, the BBC and The New York Times covered the 2025 Alawite civilian massacre on the Syrian coast — largely through a political and military lens — compared with regional channels such as Al Jazeera, Al Mayadeen and Al Akhbar, which foregrounded victims and local context.
